principle: Use medium, movement, era, and material language rather than direct imitation of living artists. Each chapter image should keep its world's style while changing subject matter to match the selected document.

h1-gongdong.styleMedium: cold urban neo-noir concept art with digital oil-paint texture, crisp architectural realism, controlled cinematic lighting, and restrained holographic overlays
h1-gongdong.palette: cobalt system blue, fluorescent white, wet asphalt gray, concrete black, muted emergency red
h1-gongdong.texture: glass, steel, rain, scanner light, floating mana haze, sharp shadows
h1-gongdong.composition: wide cinematic frames with deep urban perspective, institutional geometry, and one strong focal mechanism
h1-gongdong.avoid: cute cartoon, loose doodle, pastoral fantasy, warm storybook palettes, readable UI text

h2-hyanggung.styleMedium: Korean palace painting, colored ink wash, translucent watercolor, dancheong-inspired ornament, and delicate smoke-like brushwork
h2-hyanggung.palette: jade green, cinnabar red, pale gold, ivory paper, violet incense smoke
h2-hyanggung.texture: hanji paper grain, lacquer, silk robes, bronze incense burners, layered perfume mist
h2-hyanggung.composition: wide scroll-like scenes with palace depth, drifting scent currents, and ceremonial symmetry
h2-hyanggung.avoid: hard cyberpunk, heavy oil impasto, slapstick cartoon, modern signage, readable calligraphy

h3-seongra-gangho.styleMedium: martial ink wash painting on textured paper with mineral color accents, gold constellation linework, and restrained wuxia concept-art polish
h3-seongra-gangho.palette: ink black, moon white, indigo night, muted jade, antique gold star lines
h3-seongra-gangho.texture: brush bleed, rice paper, mist, sword light, mountain stone, star charts
h3-seongra-gangho.composition: wide mountain-and-river scroll compositions with human figures small against celestial scale
h3-seongra-gangho.avoid: bright superhero effects, cute cartoon, dense cyber UI, western medieval castle imagery

h4-gyunsahae.styleMedium: bioluminescent botanical gouache and scientific natural-history illustration blended with organic art-nouveau linework
h4-gyunsahae.tone: lush, humid, alien, symbiotic, faintly unsettling
h4-gyunsahae.palette: deep teal, spore white, mycelium gold, bruised violet, wet moss green
h4-gyunsahae.texture: fungal gills, spores, translucent membranes, damp bark, glowing threads
h4-gyunsahae.composition: wide ecological cross-sections and immersive forest-scale vistas with networked organic flow
h4-gyunsahae.avoid: sterile sci-fi metal, dry desert colors, cute mushroom mascots, horror gore

h5-sangyeoho.styleMedium: East Asian shamanic funerary folk painting with Korean mudang ritual energy, ink-wash watercolor, mineral pigment washes, bold obangsaek color fields, and talismanic paper textures
h5-sangyeoho.palette: obangsaek blue, red, yellow, white, and black; smoky ink gray; cold spirit white; muted gold; deep indigo water
h5-sangyeoho.texture: wet hanji paper, ink bleed, mineral pigment granulation, ritual paper streamers, lacquered wood, silk shrouds, ash, fog, rippling water
h5-sangyeoho.composition: wide horizontal shamanic funeral processions over water, bold ritual silhouettes, asymmetric color-blocked space, slow ceremonial movement
h5-sangyeoho.avoid: threadlike decorative linework, woven-string look, horror shock, cute cartoon, bright festival cheer, readable banners, legible calligraphy

h6-rosy-hollow.styleMedium: analog suburban psychological horror made as a photographed dollhouse diorama and faded 1970s family-album print, with gouache touch-ups, flash glare, dust, and imperfect paper grain
h6-rosy-hollow.palette: rose-pink wallpaper, faded lawn green, nicotine cream, powder blue plastic, old-photo yellow, small pools of black shadow
h6-rosy-hollow.texture: miniature furniture, glossy porcelain, clipped fake grass, wallpaper seams, camera flash bloom, film grain, scuffed photo paper
h6-rosy-hollow.composition: wide still-life diorama frames with rigid suburban symmetry, shallow staged depth, and one small impossible detail that breaks the order
h6-rosy-hollow.avoid: generic cinematic concept art, smooth fantasy lighting, bloody horror, gritty cyberpunk, messy sketching, medieval fantasy, rounded cute storybook look

h7-jeonsuseo.styleMedium: rough multi-block woodcut and old cookbook plate illustration, with hand-burnished ink, flat carved shapes, registration offsets, rice-paper stains, and limited spot color
h7-jeonsuseo.palette: sesame black ink, chili red, turmeric yellow, soy brown, steamed rice white, oxidized brass green
h7-jeonsuseo.texture: woodgrain, carved ink edges, spice dust, knife marks, ceramic glaze, oil stains, rough handmade paper
h7-jeonsuseo.composition: wide processional kitchen friezes where ingredients, tools, flames, hands, and mythic creatures are arranged like a printed scroll
h7-jeonsuseo.avoid: generic polished fantasy painting, cold sci-fi, sterile product photography, childish food doodles, readable recipe text, glossy 3D food render

h8-nubi.styleMedium: scanned textile assemblage and Korean bojagi-inspired fabric collage, built from real cloth scraps, paper patterns, appliqué silhouettes, visible pins, raw edges, and uneven hand quilting
h8-nubi.tone: handmade, tender, adventurous, tactile, quietly strange
h8-nubi.palette: indigo cloth, faded madder red, cotton cream, mustard patch, celadon thread, button brass, many muted fabric remnants
h8-nubi.texture: frayed cloth, woven grain, seams, puckered quilting, paper pattern marks, appliqué edges, thread knots, soft shadows from layered fabric
h8-nubi.composition: wide top-lit textile landscapes laid out like a photographed craft table, with sewn roads and patchwork terrain instead of painterly depth
h8-nubi.avoid: smooth digital painting, photoreal metal, slick cyberpunk, flat vector icons, overly cute nursery cartoon, perfect symmetrical quilting

h9-usabu.styleMedium: rain-blotted Korean government field ledger and landscape wash, combining sparse ink mountains, stamped administrative marks, crop-survey diagram shapes, and translucent monsoon watercolor
h9-usabu.palette: rain blue, rice-field green, cloud gray, dark roof tile, wet earth brown, restrained seal red
h9-usabu.texture: rain streaks, buckled paper, diluted ink wash, stamped pigment, stone steps, tiled roofs, wet paddies, mist
h9-usabu.composition: wide mountain terraces and official halls arranged like a weather report and land registry, with bureaucratic order softened by rain
h9-usabu.avoid: generic fantasy landscape, desert dryness, neon cyberpunk, goofy umbrella cartoon, readable documents, glossy cinematic clouds

h10-daesu.styleMedium: large-format rural mural and natural-history field plate hybrid, painted with matte casein, charcoal anatomy notes without legible text, dry-brush grass, and weathered fresco texture
h10-daesu.palette: moss green, warm earth, bone ivory, dusk gold, river blue, weathered wood, lichen gray
h10-daesu.texture: fresco cracks, dry brush, fur or hide ridges, forest canopy, village timber, soil, wind, lichen, hand-ground pigment
h10-daesu.composition: wide monumental pastoral murals where tiny villages, paths, and field-study vignettes reveal the scale of the living back beneath them
h10-daesu.avoid: generic epic concept art, cartoon mascot creature, hard sci-fi machinery, horror monster framing, cramped close-ups, glossy digital creature render
